description:
Record an audited GHG inventory in a separate append-only chain.
    mass_g is exact integer grams; content and factor-pack digests are bare
    lowercase SHA-256 hex. Idempotent on inventory_id.

agent_id.description: Id of the agent whose compute or inventory is recorded or read.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

content_digest.description: SHA-256 of the inventory content, lowercase hex without prefix.
content_digest.title: Content Digest

factor_pack_digest.description: SHA-256 of the factor pack, lowercase hex.
factor_pack_digest.title: Factor Pack Digest

factor_pack_version.description: Version of the emission factor pack used.
factor_pack_version.title: Factor Pack Version

inventory_id.description: Id of the GHG inventory, for example from ghg-ledger.
inventory_id.title: Inventory Id

mass_g.description: Inventory total in whole grams CO2e.
mass_g.title: Mass G

source_ids.description: Optional. Ids of the factor sources the inventory used.
source_ids.title: Source Ids

name: record_inventory
title: Record inventory
